laws: Every citizen must wave at passing utes.
Bad grammar in public is a misdemeanour; the Treasurer is judge, jury and red pen.
The rain gauge reading is a national broadcast and must be listened to in silence.
Bedtime may be extended by presidential decree on special occasions.
Any dispute is settled by a game; junior citizens hold the casting vote.
No mining company may enter Parristan without the Treasurer knowing first.
